explanation: Venus makes the closest approaches but spends long spells on the far side of the Sun. Mercury never strays far from the Sun, so its average distance from Earth is smaller.

claims.text: Averaged over time, Mercury is the planet closest to Earth.
Averaged over time, Venus, Mars and Jupiter are each farther from Earth than Mercury is.
At its closest approaches, Venus comes nearer to Earth than any other planet.
Venus spends long periods on the far side of the Sun from Earth.
Mercury's small orbit keeps it close to the Sun, so its distance from Earth stays near the Earth-Sun distance on average.
